## Appearance

Charlie Sloane is notable for his distinctively goggle-shaped eyes. Their prominent, goggly appearance is visible during the day and appears even more pronounced in the moonlight.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P23](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0023), [v3 ch.Autumn P6](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0006)_

## Personality

Charlie Sloane harbors a long-standing ambition to enter politics. His primary goal is to eventually serve as a member of Parliament.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)_

## History

Charlie Sloane was known to indulge in literary flights in times past. He later traveled to [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport) alongside [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) to attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). During his time at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), Charlie joined [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and their mutual friends on social outings, including a walk through the park to view Patty's Place. During his second term at the university, Charlie proposed to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), but she rejected his proposal, creating tension between them.

_Sources: [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P0](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0000), [v3 ch.Farewell P2](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0002), [v3 ch.Farewell P4](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0004), [v3 ch.Farewell P10](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0010), [v3 ch.Farewell P24](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0024), [v3 ch.Park P14](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0014), +7 more_

## Relationships

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlie-sloane--gilbert-blythe.md)

Charlie and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) are longtime friends who share a history originating in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), eventually traveling together by train and boat to attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) in [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport). While they maintain a close friendship and socialize in the same collegiate group, they also function as rivals for the romantic affection of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). Their shared college life involves participating in campus events together, such as the freshman Arts Rush led by [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and autumn group walks through [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport).

_Sources: [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P0](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0000), [v3 ch.Farewell P2](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0002), [v3 ch.Farewell P4](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0004), +10 more_

- Rival of — rivals for the affection of Anne (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P0](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0000)</sub>
